name: White Chocolate Pumpkin Spice Latte
flavor_notes: A warm, comforting latte combining espresso with the sweet, aromatic flavors of white chocolate and pumpkin spice.
barista_note: Warm the mug first so the milk and coffee stay hot to the last sip.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
preparations.tested_with: Counter Culture Big Trouble or Joe Coffee The Daily

ingredients.notes: A little stronger than the original: Cometeer capsules can't be split. For less caffeine, use Half Caff (~90 mg) or Decaf capsules; same flavor.

steps: In your serving mug, combine White Chocolate Syrup.
Melt the Cometeer capsule (about 5 minutes submerged in hot water, or overnight in the fridge). Pour it into the mug over the syrups and spices; stir until fully dissolved.
Warm and froth milk to about 140°F (60°C). Pour the frothed milk over the coffee, holding back the foam, then spoon the velvety foam on top.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
preparations.tested_with: Nescafé Gold Espresso or Mount Hagen Organic
steps: In your serving mug, combine White Chocolate Syrup.
Dissolve 1 tsp instant espresso in 1 oz (30 ml) hot water directly in the mug over the syrups and spices; stir until completely dissolved.
Warm and froth milk to about 140°F (60°C). Pour the frothed milk over the coffee, holding back the foam, then spoon the velvety foam on top.
